prompt.title: Claude has written up a plan and is ready to execute. Would you like to proceed?

notes: Real ExitPlanMode dialog (plan mode, 'Ready to code?'). No deny option, so kind=question and the Deny button uses esc. The hint line 'shift+tab to approve with this feedback' under option 3 is not part of its label. The numbered plan steps inside the ╌ block above are not the menu. Digit 2 approved immediately.
